about: Format 3's objects in binary (object format 2; docs/specs/232.md, part E), written by hand from the shapes of reader/hellolink-format/src/objects.rs. `payload` is the object's bytes after its format byte and before its check; `json` is what it reads as. LEB128 puts 7 bits a byte, the lowest first; zigzag maps d to 2d (d >= 0) and -2d-1 (d < 0); a hash is 16 bits little-endian.

objects.name: object 26: one aura of the player, none of the target
